review_rationale: Recurring House elections and vacancy-election procedures provide a limited institutional correspondence.
scope_limitations: Article I Section 2 does not expressly prohibit refusal to call elections following colonial legislative dissolutions.

review_rationale: The naturalization power corresponds to the naturalization component of the colonial grievance.
scope_limitations: The cited clause does not establish unrestricted immigration, land appropriation, or naturalization rights.

review_rationale: Article III establishes federal judicial power and provides for federal judicial institutions.
scope_limitations: Institutional correspondence does not establish a specific causal relationship between the grievance and Article III.

review_rationale: Article II provides appointment mechanisms and allocates appointment responsibilities.
scope_limitations: The appointments clause does not independently prohibit excessive offices, harassment, or administrative expenditures.
